question: Five men Ankit, Bishal, Chandler, Daksh and Joey are sitting at a horizontal table facing north. Ankit is to the immediate left of Daksh who is not at the corner. Joey is exactly in between Bishal and Chandler. Who is sitting at the leftmost end?
solution:
**Given :** Five men Ankit, Bishal, Chandler, Daksh and Joey are sitting at a horizontal table facing north.

**Explanation : **

1) Ankit is to the immediate left of Daksh who is not at the corner.

As position of Daksh is not definite yet, therefore there are three possible position for Daksh.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e382c09f76bef7aa523b7acce70fd467d91cbf6754829220a4711321e39dded.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d4e7aa137a38a72d26b62b29c0dd71a1b44f53fcb52cde22b62749568efc0c8.png] 

 
• Case - (3) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bc6d4f97a09b29c3f5835132637d5db4ab0f19b700295a65aa3a966522f2101.png] 

2) Joey is exactly in between Bishal and Chandler.

As there is possible position for Joey with respect to Bishal and Chandler in case - (2) and case - (3), therefore both the cases are eliminated.

As position Bishal and Chandler with respect to Joey is not known yet, therefore there are two possible positions for both Bishal and Chandler.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/533c0ca04cb536e9082cf745b9d70f4bd7f1ab1fb92922915bc4b43690dd61e6.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Ankit is sitting at the leftmost end.

Hence, **"Ankit"** is the correct answer.
